description: The approved geoa fixes that are NOT yet written into this site's code, for sites built or updated with Claude Code. Each item carries the path (url_pattern), the new value to write, and what geoa measured there before, so you can find the right spot in the repo. A human already approved every item in geoa before it appears here. Read-only. Requires sign-in to a geoa account.
